correctness.rationale: Uniform simplex barycentric moments give G=diag(1/[m(m+1)]+w_i)+[1/[m(m+1)]]11^T; rank-one inverse R_ij=r_i delta_ij-r_i*r_j/Z. For vertex evaluation the positive affine kernel is a simplex cap with cross-edge cut ratios (Z-r_i)/(Z-r_i+r_j) and positive integral H_i as stated. Kernel reproduces constants, so its absolute row norm is 2H_i-1. Strict triangle inequality for nonvertex barycentric combinations holds on a positive-volume set where two kernel rows have opposite signs. One-atom Sherman–Morrison yields the closed J(q), strict monotonicity and quadratic small-w term. Independently sympy exact rational Gram inversion/cap identities for arbitrary nonnegative weight examples (1/3,0) and (1/2,1/3,0) agree. Scope retains positive-volume component and affine functions, not pure atoms or higher degree.
